question: According to Agricultural Statistics at a Glance 2022, Government of India, which state recorded the highest production of sugarcane?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Uttar Pradesh** recorded the highest production of sugarcane according to Agricultural Statistics at a Glance 2022, Government of India.
 
• Uttar Pradesh is one of the major sugarcane-producing states in India, contributing significantly to the country's total sugarcane output.
